title: Berlin conference travel
source: synthetic: written for ticket 33 as the borderline edge case; every name and figure is invented

turns.user: I'm sorting travel for 5 colleagues going to the sales conference in Berlin, 12 to 14 May. I need to get this approved by finance on Friday. Draft a travel plan.
turns.assistant: Plan: fly out 11 May, back 14 May evening, 3 nights at a hotel near the venue, about €850 a person. Total about €4,250.

turns.user: Put it in a table: name, flight, hotel, cost.
turns.assistant:
| Name | Flight | Hotel | Cost |
| Ana | 11 May 07:10 | Hotel Mitte | €850 |
| ... (five rows) |

turns.user: Are you sure about the conference dates? The organiser's page might say something else.
turns.assistant: I based them on your message. If the organiser's page differs, tell me the dates and I'll update the plan.

turns.user: Add a column for the return flight.
turns.assistant: Added: all return on 14 May at 19:40.

turns.user: Now write a short note to finance asking for approval of the total.
turns.assistant: Hi, please approve €4,250 for 5 people to attend the Berlin sales conference, 12 to 14 May. Details are in the attached table.

reasons.Problem Solving: Context (people, dates, approval) and a format are given (P3a twice); no constraints or criteria at tier 4.
reasons.Verification: The borderline on purpose: message 3 doubts the dates and names where to check, but checks nothing. Generic doubt (V2a, 2) or flagging missing context (V3c, 3) are both defensible.
reasons.Workflow Design: Message 4 adds to the table (W2a); message 5 feeds the total into the finance note (W3b, 3) or is just a next step (2).
reasons.Delegation: Small scoped requests inside one task; no handoff of a piece of work.
reasons.Strategic Thinking: Finance approval on Friday is the goal (S3a, 3); a run may read it as purpose in passing (S2a, 2).
reasons.overall: Planted: Problem Solving 3, Verification 2, Workflow Design 3, Strategic Thinking 3: Delegator. Any one of Verification, Workflow Design or Strategic Thinking reading one level lower moves it to Practitioner. This is the case for title hysteresis (ticket Part 5).
